title: Every unit of blood a hospital uses began with someone in a donor chair
alt: A part-filled blood bag lying in a tray on a mixing scale, its tube running up out of the frame, over a patterned carpet.

posts.facebook:
Read the eligibility rules from NHS Blood and Transplant in England or the American Red Cross, then book an appointment at a donor centre or blood drive near you. On the day, answer the health and lifestyle check honestly and accept the service's decision.

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/give-blood/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
